assertion_results.text: Step 4.2 detects the pre-existing 'Related' link to TC-8001 and skips link creation — does NOT call jira.create_link (§1.58)
assertion_results.evidence: sibling-check.md Step 4.2 states: '**Result**: A matching link already exists on TC-8006: Link ID: 1990401, Type: Related, Direction: outward (TC-8006 --> TC-8001). **Action**: Skip link creation.
